all 20 column, row and cell quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)

our code answers every question from the table itself: "top-rate-lookup" (lookup) → rows[5] "37%"; "largest-joint-limit" (largest) → rows[5] "$768,700"; "smallest-rate" (smallest) → rows[0] "12%" (questions-valid)
the chart draws the numeric column 1 ("Married") (chart-valid)

the progressive-rate calculator runs on the page's own brackets: an example income of 640600 takes 159268.5 across 5 bracket(s) — thresholds strictly ascending, rates ascending within 0..100 (brackets-valid)

every number in the title, the label header, the column headers and units and the row labels appears on the cited page (N-01); cell values are bound to their quotes as printed by DT-03 (numbers-checkable)
